1. [ ] Check the event sign-up list and confirm the expected attendance count.
2. [ ] Set aside one map and one scorecard per confirmed attendee. For **N attendees**, you need **N maps and N scorecards**.
3. [ ] Recheck attendance immediately before assembly. If the count changes, adjust both material quantities to match the latest count.
4. [ ] Assemble one kit per attendee, with one map and one scorecard in each. Count the completed kits and check their contents.
5. [ ] Place all kits on the welcome table before doors open, allowing enough time for assembly and a final count.

named_stages: The numbered actions are not grouped into named stages.
